verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Orama as an in-process/embedded JS search library and a managed 'Orama Cloud' offering, but there is no documentation of clustering, replication, sharding, or high-availability architecture, nor any stated capacity/scale numbers (e.g., hundreds of millions of documents). The only scale-related claim is a marketing tagline ('Run Orama at scale. Managed.') with no architectural detail.
